correctness.rationale: Pair counting of 4 lines and 4 triple points gives a=0 line-only triples, b=4 conic-line-line triples, 2 residual line-line nodes; otherwise a=1 would force a line to meet the conic in 3 distinct points. The triple incidence graph is a 4-cycle of conic chords. PGL2 acts triply transitively on the smooth conic, producing the normal form Fλ=(xz−y²)y(x−y)(x−(1+λ)y+λz)(y−λz), λ≠0,1. The explicit quadratic syzygy A Fx+B Fy+C Fz=0 and full-rank linear-syzygy minor 108λ² imply mdr=2; τ=2+4·4=18 and degree-six near-free characterization imply exponents (2,4). Independently at λ=2, symbolic F calculation verified syzygy and rank9 of the full 22×9 coefficient matrix. Nonconstant unordered j(λ) establishes positive-dimensional projective family; finite check supplements original all-λ algebra.
